paragraphs: 一早，雷米睡醒後走出房間，前往從窗外望見的農田。廣袤的麥田裡，只有屈指可數的農夫。雷米試圖和農夫打聲招呼，卻沒有得到回應。不久後，他感到些許無趣，便走回旅店門口，看見同行的夥伴們已在門口等待了。
隨著從雷米身後悠悠走來的喜利・歐喜利歸隊，薩梅爾、YHWH、米多莉、波、雷米和喜利・歐喜利離開了旅社，朝前一晚出發時所在的城牆邊走去。此時早已收好營帳的龍恩正在打坐。大夥兒簡單討論後，決定先回到麥克嵩城內。薩梅爾想去找法朗茲，而YHWH則是想去向月先生致意。
麥克嵩城門的衛兵無精打采，大家輕輕鬆鬆就走入了城內。已經熟悉麥克嵩主要幹道的台北市議員很快就回到派頓事務所。敲了敲門，月先生邀請大家入內。
在辦公室內看見紫羅蘭，YHWH打了打招呼，和紫羅蘭說明她的兒子帕拉丁爵士已和他們分道揚鑣，決定前往瑟巴諾尋找線索。同時，紫羅蘭也說明了她會等弗列里夫人的身體恢復得更好一些，再與弗列里夫婦一同前往寇林菲爾德。在YHWH的請託下，紫羅蘭將頭上的髮簪取了下來，遞給YHWH，希望能作為信物，讓台北市議員在麥丁頓王國旅行時可以少遇到點困難。
另一方面，米多莉看見有點不知所措的蘿琳默默站在龍恩身後。米多莉前去鼓勵她。蘿琳鼓足勇氣，從龍恩的身後拍了拍他的肩膀，而就在龍恩轉身面對她時，蘿琳便吻上了他的雙唇。
此時並沒有飛鼠般的肉色幻影從背後天花板的角落瞬間移動。並沒有。
蘿琳結束親吻，在龍恩耳邊輕聲低語後，一回頭發現眾人都在看著她，便羞赧地跑走，留下龍恩呆呆地站在原地。

薩梅爾向月先生坦承，自己的父母是月神教的瘋狂信徒，因此讓他初次認識月先生時有極大的戒心。同時，YHWH也向月先生詢問了關於月神教的問題，也請教他，日後冒險時若遇到拉索斯教與崔尼斯教等大型宗教的干涉，該如何應對。月先生表示宗教信仰是讓脆弱的人在需要幫助時，有個可以依靠的東西，只要足夠堅強，就算沒有信仰，也能撐過一切的。月先生也分享了自己年輕時，和月神教做過的交易：雖然沒有說明自己換得了什麼，但外表看來約三十多歲的他，壽命其實已快到盡頭了，也許等台北市議員下次回到麥克嵩，月先生就已不在人世。
接著，月先生走到了儲物間，要拿點東西給台北市議員。在台北市議員討論拉索斯教的過程中，他們看見蘿琳從門外進來，手上拎了好多袋東西。接著，她便一一將剛買的沙威瑪分送給了冒險者們，讓他們填飽肚子。月先生也分送給每位冒險者一顆白色透光的小石頭，讓他們隨身攜帶，並表示當他們有需要時，便會知道該如何使用它，而月神芬尼爾會陪在他們身邊的。
台北市議員從月先生那裡打聽到法朗茲回到了先前他所住的布蘭登角落。與月先生等人道別後，他們便出發前往位於艾德蒙餐館旁的布蘭登角落。YHWH、米多莉和波決定先在艾德蒙餐館店內等待其他人，順便簡單休息一下。

薩梅爾、龍恩、雷米和喜利・歐喜利等人來到了布蘭登角落的櫃檯，經過詢問後，發現現在只有一間客房有住人，同時他們也聽到了客房內傳來了陣陣琴聲。在櫃檯人員敲了敲門後，門被打開了縫隙。一隻睜大的眼睛望向門外的薩梅爾。接著法朗茲將門大開，邀請大家趕緊進到房內，然後趕走了櫃檯人員。房內昏暗，只有窗外透入些許微光。法朗茲的小書桌上堆滿了字跡潦草的紙條，蓬頭垢面的他神經兮兮地向大家說明自己的發現，並拿出他漆成黑色的魯特琴，開始演奏。聽起來古怪弔詭的曲調，訴說著關於拉索斯教與暗影之父的故事。法朗茲表示過去殺死他夥伴的暗影之父，與他們這次遇到的是同一隻惡魔，只是似乎由不同的人幻化而成。依他判斷，暗影之父應該會附身或幻化成不同的人。
經過討論後，法朗茲表示自己想繼續追查暗影之父與拉索斯教的線索，因此想和台北市議員一起冒險。雖然法朗茲變得有些神經質，薩梅爾、龍恩、雷米和喜利・歐喜利最終還是同意了，雷米甚至將法朗茲視為兄弟。
五人離開了布蘭登角落，回到艾德蒙餐館與米多莉等人會面。用餐期間，法朗茲向雷米表示，自己花了些時間，學會了拉索斯語，並用拉索斯語寫下「拉索斯」這個名字，表示自己願意教雷米拉索斯語。
經過討論後，大家決定在飯後簡單分頭行動：雷米和喜利・歐喜利要去麥克嵩的盜賊公會打探消息，其他人則想去看看有沒有租賃或購買馬車的可能性。大家約好日落前在城門集合。

雷米帶著喜利・歐喜利來到了麥克嵩的盜賊公會，尋找過去夥伴的蹤跡。公會一如往常，沒有任何人影。雷米發現上回來到這裡看見的訊息消失了，取而代之的是一句連他也看不懂的盜賊語。喜利・歐喜利試著解讀後，只能確認那是一個名字。喜利・歐喜利還發現，雷米在公會內那位同名好兄弟的置物處，有遭魔法動過手腳的痕跡，讓人有點起疑，不過雷米還是留了訊息給這位好兄弟，表示自己現在的一些夥伴正前往瑟巴諾，希望對方有機會能前去協助他們。最後，雷米發現公會的傳話人低語者似乎不久前有在這裡活動的蹤跡，但卻不知去向。兩人到了雷米上次與低語者見面的雜貨店門口，卻沒有發現任何蹤跡，而雜貨店似乎也已經幾週沒有人活動了。
離開雜貨店後，雷米和喜利・歐喜利回到雷米在貧民窟的家，看見待在門口的勇哥十分虛弱，似乎是脫水了。雷米想尋找附近的水源，喜利・歐喜利卻突然跑走了。附近的水井似乎是乾的，而且好像通往了地底下；附近的民宅幾乎都空了，而且都沒有水可以用。不久後，喜利・歐喜利提了一大桶水走了過來，是他到附近的店購買的。給勇哥喝水之後，兩人便牽著勇哥，往約定好的城門口走去。

米多莉和YHWH帶著波去拜訪大衛醫師。來到了他的診間，裡頭全是麥克嵩的傷者。大衛醫師和波似乎早已認識，讓米多莉有點小訝異。米多莉進了大衛醫師的辦公室，想向他詢問關於波的事，同時也詢問看看能否讓波待在這裡。依照大衛醫師的說法，波的父母過去做過木工，賣過雜貨，簡單來說各種工作都做過，但是都做不久。波雖然年紀小，但是卻十分配合她的父母。米多莉也簡單詢問了關於城內拉索斯教的影響力，大衛醫師則表示拉索斯教似乎是在近年才進入麥克嵩的。
辦公室外，波在米多莉的允諾下，在診間到處晃晃，而YHWH則在後面確認波沒有在搗蛋。出乎意料的是，波似乎和診間內的家庭、小朋友都很熟識，而且大家對她的態度都很好。波陪著其他受傷的小朋友玩耍、扮鬼臉，連YHWH都加入，陪波一起玩。
與大衛醫師談完後，米多莉似乎感應到了她所信奉的神祇津菈。體內的聲音答應實現她一個小小的願望，而米多莉則默默許下，希望波可以平安長大。與診間內的傷者們以及大衛醫師道別後，米多莉、YHWH和波一同離開，準備往城門走去。
薩梅爾、龍恩和法朗茲三人經過打聽後，到了城門邊尋找可以租用或購買馬車的地方。據說，外觀最破舊的凱瑞車行，價格最為划算。經過實際探查後，三人決定向凱瑞車行的老闆賴瑞購買適合一家人乘坐的雙馬馬車，以及一匹名叫斯比迪的馬（另一匹可由雷米騎來的勇哥，或米多莉召喚的坐騎輪流擔任）。老闆也另外贈送了他們足供兩匹馬吃一週的草料，讓馬兒不會餓肚子。
因為時間還早，在法朗茲的請求下，薩梅爾和龍恩帶他到了傳說中的小黑屋。法朗茲從口袋中掏出了大把金幣，詢問施瓦茨和達里歐兩人的下落。令薩梅爾和龍恩意外的是，他們並沒有聽到任何回應，法朗茲卻點了點頭道謝，然後準備離開。據法朗茲說明，他過去的冒險團暗影追蹤者四人中，除了遇害的內巴隆和他自己，另外兩名成員施瓦茨與達里歐都躲了起來，但是他想要去找他們兩人，挖掘一些關於拉索斯與暗影之父的消息。
大家在城門口見面後，決定讓雷米餵過勇哥後，牽著虛弱的牠步行，其他人則坐上薩梅爾駕的馬車，往南方前進。龍恩則決定坐在馬車頂打坐乘涼。

在路程中，法朗茲也更詳細地說明自己過去冒險團的故事。最初，人類「正義者」內巴隆是拉索斯的信徒，卻在發現拉索斯教的邪惡後，決定背棄它。內巴隆先遇上妖精「赤心」施瓦茨，接著結識「藍者」法朗茲，最後是半獸人「剛力」達里歐。內巴隆也發現了法朗茲的慧根，而決定教他拉索斯語。四人尋覓拉索斯與暗影之父的秘密，最終卻在一個妖精的部落內慘遭暗影之父襲擊：做法與麥克嵩相似，暗影之父喬裝成他們認識的人，最終化為惡魔，而內巴隆被暗影之父扯斷四肢，就此喪命。在那之後，施瓦茨和達里歐都決定隱姓埋名，逃得遠遠的，只剩法朗茲繼續找尋拉索斯的秘密。
從麥克嵩前往西南方的多侖維爾市中心，原本約需一小時。為了配合虛弱的勇哥，馬車以步行的速度前進，天色也漸漸暗了下來，雨也開始落下。在大家停下馬匹討論後，決定趕緊往前，市中心也已經不遠了。
來到了多侖維爾的街道上，YHWH向路人詢問適合夜宿的地方，得到了一個叫馬戲團旅店的店名。然而，為了躲雨，大家便在最近的酒館停了下來。走入醉漢酒館，裡面人不多，花了點時間和老闆殺價後，大家有了個大通鋪可以過夜。和老闆詢問後，因為覺得餐點太貴，最終只有雷米、法朗茲和波等人留下來用餐，其他幾人則在街上找了間看起來生意比較好的店家吃飯。
用餐期間，YHWH也向米多莉詢問了關於接下來往方努爾市的路。米多莉簡單說明，向南方前進後，會到一個叫新莫里斯的城市，屆時大家會下馬車，坐船前往方努爾市。
為了保護花了大筆錢買的馬車和斯比迪，眾人決定趁著人手充足，安排每次兩人輪流守夜。

首先，龍恩和YHWH兩人坐在馬車上閒聊著，討論斯比迪會不會其實是德魯伊變成的馬，以及德魯伊的市價等話題。一段時間後，龍恩發現酒館對街似乎讓他感到不太對勁。龍恩和YHWH決定前去調查。此時，龍恩腦中突然響起一陣短暫、極高頻的刺耳聲，但是找不到來源。來到了對街房屋前的草皮，龍恩藉著YHWH升起的篝火照明，找到了一顆表面凹凸不平，像是金屬的礦石。兩人並不清楚這顆石頭是什麼來歷，保險起見，先收進次元袋裡，明天再問問團隊中「肯定」對礦石十分了解的喜利・歐喜利。

守夜結束後，YHWH大剌剌地走回房門口敲門，吵醒了剛入睡不久的夥伴，惹得大家有些不悅。米多莉帶著十分期待守夜的波，和似乎有話想對她說的雷米一同來到馬車旁。依照龍恩與YHWH剛才的說明，他們也到對街發現奇怪礦石的角落調查了一番，此時米多莉感到頭部有些刺痛。雷米向米多莉談起安納戴克和家亨遇害的那晚，除了隱瞞關鍵的家族名稱，幾乎毫無保留地說明了整件事的經過（旁邊的波則興趣缺缺）。回到馬車旁後，雷米又說，自那之後，他每天晚上都得回報當天的經歷，並親自示範。這時，波突然發現米多莉的左前臂有些異樣。米多莉仔細一看，才發現雙前臂的皮膚都變得烏黑，像大象皮一樣，還長著粗短的硬毛，和當時布羅克的皮膚一模一樣。
米多莉雙手合十，閉上雙眼，向津菈禱告。在聆聽津菈的回應時，突然「嘣」聲巨響。米多莉聽到波尖叫。米多莉感到左手劇烈刺痛。唯獨雷米，沒有傳來任何聲音。
睜開雙眼，米多莉看見波的右臂從肩膀以下整個消失，自己的左臂則是從手肘以下消失了，兩人的傷口卻像已經癒合一般，雖然劇痛不已，卻沒有血肉模糊的慘狀。米多莉的右手手掌也像是無法施力一般，垂了下來。雷米則不見了，只留下了地上散落的肉塊、曾經穿在他身上的布料，以及那串曾經掛在太太我還要、烏柯，以及他自己脖子上的項鍊。
在雷米的意識消失前的最後一刻，他回想起了和這群夥伴們冒險的過往，以及從小在麥克嵩生活的點滴，與那位同名好兄弟雷米相識的過程等。然後，雷米聽見了好兄弟雷米熟悉的聲音。「拉席夫・達麥克嵩，跟我走吧！」接著什麼都沒有了。

爆炸的聲響以及波淒慘的尖叫聲響遍了多侖維爾，附近所有住戶都跑出來遠觀。冒險者們也都驚醒，跑了出來。受到極度驚嚇的波完全說不出話，跪在地上，瘋狂地用頭敲地面。在請酒館老闆去找醫生後，YHWH（拿了雷米留下的項鍊，掛在自己脖子上。他似乎感受到這條項鍊與他所信奉的詐欺之神烏提森有所關聯）陪同米多莉以及抱著似乎是累到昏去的波的法朗茲，先回房間內休息。龍恩和喜利・歐喜利以及帶著酷爆出來的薩梅爾陷入了震驚，思索著該怎麼做。薩梅爾先將酷爆留在馬車旁，並與兩位夥伴來到酒館門口。幾位住在酒館的旅客也倉皇跑了出來，想搞清楚發生什麼事。
不久後，三人聽見了激烈的馬叫聲，然後一個陌生的身影騎著斯比迪從酒館的轉角快速衝了出來。機警的三人趕緊用盡了各種方法，連哄帶騙、連滾帶爬地將這名竊馬賊以及斯比迪制止住了，並分工合作地把斯比迪牽回酒館旁。龍恩嘗試和竊馬賊問話，對方卻似乎在中了喜利・歐喜利的法術狂笑不止後喘不過氣，無法回話。

薩梅爾將斯比迪牽回酒館旁時，看見了酷爆正在啃食地上原本是雷米的肉塊。薩梅爾氣得鬆開原本牽著斯比迪的韁繩，要去把酷爆抱起來。斯比迪見狀，想往前衝去，嚇到了滿嘴肉塊的酷爆，酷爆轉頭向後跑，撞到了神情疲憊不已的勇哥，勇哥也只有苦苦低鳴一聲的力氣。喜利・歐喜利趕緊抓住斯比迪的韁繩，帶到酒館旁綁好，薩梅爾也將酷爆抱起，以免他再吃更多肉塊。此時，薩梅爾站在窗外，似乎聽見他們住的房間裡傳來一陣歌聲，讓他回想起了家鄉，歌詞的語言有點熟悉，卻又似乎不是妖精語。
一陣混亂之後，酒館的門打開了，老闆告訴龍恩醫生來了，眾人便趕緊趕回房內。
在米多莉、YHWH、法朗茲與波回到房間後，YHWH和米多莉討論著接下來該怎麼辦。米多莉計畫著在醫生將她與波的傷勢穩定下來後，再繼續前往方努爾市。法朗茲在一旁聽了，大為憤怒，表示今天陷入了這樣的危險，波被炸斷了一隻手，再繼續這樣闖下去，要是再斷一條腿，說不定到方努爾市時，波早就連四肢都沒了。米多莉要法朗茲提出有用的建議，法朗茲來回踱步，也想不出好方法，一氣之下，便離開了房間。

不久後，他們聽見了敲門聲。酒館老闆帶了一個人來到了房間。此人全身膚色蒼白，頭髮也是銀白色的，就連衣服也是一身白，唯有她的雙眼是碧藍色的。這位外觀看起來二十初頭的女子自我介紹是白醫師，算是多侖維爾當地的醫生。在米多莉的請託下，白醫師先檢查了已經睡去的波，而她似乎也一看就判斷出了這是拉索斯教搞的鬼。YHWH起身要去告訴其他夥伴醫生來了，老闆則自告奮勇接下這個任務。白醫師坐在波身邊，唱起了歌。歌聲十分溫和舒緩，讓米多莉也感到放鬆許多。

薩梅爾、龍恩和喜利・歐喜利走回了房間門口，看見那名陌生的女子，也聽見了她的歌聲。薩梅爾開口詢問對方是誰，女子先是用了普通語，告訴大家她叫白醫師，接著用了妖精語，對著薩梅爾說了一句「歡迎回家」，接著便是一陣刺眼的白光，還有龍恩的大聲嘶吼「這種會唱歌的女生，我就知道一定怪怪的！」，充斥著整個房間。喜利・歐喜利努力靠著自己的意志抗拒這未知的魔法。在他睜開雙眼時，發現整個房間只剩下他一個人。房門又被打開了，法朗茲走了進來，露出狐疑的眼神，問了一句：「人呢？怎麼都不見了？」

Early that morning, Lemmy left his room and headed for the farmland he had seen through the window. Only a handful of farmers worked the vast wheat fields. He tried greeting them but received no response. Soon bored, he returned to the inn, where his companions were already waiting outside.

Siri Oslee strolled up behind Lemmy and rejoined the group. Samael, YHWH, Midori, Beau, Lemmy, and Siri then left the inn for the stretch of city wall they had set out from the previous evening. Ron had already packed up his tent and was meditating there. After a brief discussion, they decided to return to Macksohn: Samael wanted to find Franz, while YHWH wanted to pay his respects to Mr. Moon.

The guards at Macksohn's gate were listless, and the party entered without difficulty. Already familiar with the city's main streets, the Councilors of Taipei soon reached Patton's. They knocked, and Mr. Moon invited them inside.

YHWH greeted the Violet in the office and explained that her son, Syr Paladin, had parted ways with them to search for clues in Sebano. She said she would travel to Korringfield with the Flaerrys once Mrs. Flaerry had recovered further. At YHWH's request, she removed her hairpin and gave it to him as a token that might ease the Councilors' travels through the Kingdom of Mattington.

Meanwhile, Midori noticed Roline standing hesitantly behind Ron and went over to encourage her. Gathering her courage, Roline tapped Ron on the shoulder. As he turned around, she kissed him on the lips.
At that moment, no flesh-colored, flying-squirrel-like blur teleported from a corner of the ceiling behind them. None at all.
Breaking the kiss, Roline whispered in Ron's ear. Then she turned, realized everyone was watching, and fled in embarrassment, leaving Ron standing there in a daze.

Samael confessed to Mr. Moon that his parents were fanatical followers of the Moon God Cult, which had made him deeply wary when they first met. YHWH also asked about the cult and sought advice on dealing with powerful religious groups such as the Laxthos Cult and the Trinix Cult. Mr. Moon said faith gave vulnerable people something to rely on, but those who were strong enough could endure without it. He also spoke of a bargain he had made with the Moon God Cult in his youth. He did not reveal what he had received, but although he appeared to be in his thirties, his life was nearly over. He might already be dead by the time the Councilors next returned to Macksohn.

Mr. Moon went to the storeroom to fetch something for the party. While the Councilors discussed the Laxthos Cult, Roline returned carrying several bags and handed out the shawarma she had bought. Mr. Moon then gave each adventurer a small, translucent white stone to carry. He said they would know how to use it when the need arose, and that Phyneal, the moon god, would be with them.

Mr. Moon told them Franz had returned to Brandon's Corner, where he had stayed before. After saying their goodbyes, the party headed there, next to Edmond's Diner. YHWH, Midori, and Beau waited in the diner and took a short rest.

Samael, Ron, Lemmy, and Siri asked at the front desk of Brandon's Corner and learned that only one guest room was occupied. Music drifted from inside. A staff member knocked, and the door opened a crack, revealing a wide eye staring at Samael. Franz then threw the door open, hurried them inside, and dismissed the staff member. The room was dark except for faint light from the window, and his small desk was covered in hastily scrawled notes. Disheveled and agitated, Franz explained his discoveries, then played his black-painted lute. Its eerie melody told of the Laxthos Cult and the Father of Shadows. He believed the demon they had encountered was the same one that had killed his companion, though it had emerged from a different person. He suspected the Father of Shadows could possess people or take their forms.

Franz wanted to keep investigating the Father of Shadows and the Laxthos Cult, and asked to travel with the Councilors. Despite his increasingly erratic behavior, Samael, Ron, Lemmy, and Siri agreed. Lemmy even came to regard Franz as a brother.

The five returned to Edmond's Diner to rejoin the others. Over the meal, Franz told Lemmy he had spent time learning Laxthosian. He wrote out the name "Laxthos" in that language and offered to teach him.

They agreed to split up after eating. Lemmy and Siri would seek information at Macksohn's Thieves' Guild, while the others looked into renting or buying a carriage. Everyone would meet at the city gate before sunset.

Lemmy took Siri to the Thieves' Guild to look for signs of his former companions. As usual, it was deserted. The message Lemmy had seen on his previous visit was gone, replaced by a line of thieves' cant that even he could not decipher. Siri could only determine that it was a name. He also noticed traces of magical tampering around the storage space belonging to Remmy, Lemmy's close friend in the guild. Despite his suspicions, Lemmy left Remmy a message explaining that some of his companions were heading to Sebano and asking him to help them if he could. Lemmy also found signs that the guild's messenger, Whisperer, had been there recently, but no clue to his whereabouts. They checked the grocery store where Lemmy had last met him, only to find it apparently untouched for weeks.

Lemmy and Siri returned to Lemmy's home in the slums and found Yung outside, weak and apparently dehydrated. Lemmy searched for water while Siri suddenly ran off. The nearby well was dry and seemed to lead underground; the surrounding houses were mostly empty and had no water either. Siri soon returned with a large bucket he had bought from a nearby shop. After giving Yung water, they led him toward the city gate.

Midori and YHWH took Beau to visit Dr. David, whose clinic was full of Macksohn's wounded. To Midori's surprise, the doctor already knew Beau. Midori went into his office to ask about her and whether she could stay there. Dr. David explained that her parents had tried carpentry, selling groceries, and many other jobs, but never stayed with any for long. Despite her youth, Beau had always cooperated with them. Midori also asked about the Laxthos Cult's influence, and Dr. David said it seemed to have arrived in Macksohn only in recent years.

With Midori's permission, Beau wandered around the clinic while YHWH followed to keep her out of trouble. Surprisingly, she knew many of the families and children there, and everyone treated her warmly. She played with the injured children and made faces at them; even YHWH joined in.

After speaking with Dr. David, Midori sensed the presence of her god, Keinra. The voice within her offered to grant a small wish, and she silently wished that Beau could grow up safely. Midori, YHWH, and Beau then said goodbye to the doctor and his patients and headed for the city gate.

After asking around, Samael, Ron, and Franz found a carriage dealer near the gate. They had been told the shabbiest shop, Kerry's, offered the best value. After inspecting its stock, they bought a family-sized two-horse carriage and one horse named Speedy from its owner, Larry. Yung or a mount summoned by Midori could take turns as the second horse. Larry also included a week's fodder for two horses.

With time to spare, Samael and Ron took Franz to the legendary little black room at his request. Franz produced a handful of gold coins and asked where he could find Schwartz and Dario. His companions heard no answer, yet Franz nodded, gave his thanks, and prepared to leave. He explained that his former party, the Shadow Trackers, had had four members. Nebalon had been killed; the other two, Schwartz and Dario, had gone into hiding. Franz wanted to find them and learn more about Laxthos and the Father of Shadows.

They reunited at the city gate. After feeding the weakened Yung, Lemmy led him on foot, while the others rode south in the carriage with Samael driving. Ron sat on the roof to meditate and enjoy the breeze.

On the road, Franz told them more about the Shadow Trackers. Nebalon the Just, a human, had worshipped Laxthos until he discovered the cult's evil and abandoned it. He met the elf Schwartz the Redhearted, then Franz the Blue, and finally the half-orc Dario the Mighty. Recognizing Franz's aptitude, Nebalon taught him Laxthosian. The four investigated Laxthos and the Father of Shadows, but the demon attacked them in an elven settlement. As in Macksohn, it had disguised itself as someone they knew before revealing its demonic form. It tore off Nebalon's limbs, killing him. Schwartz and Dario then fled and went into hiding, leaving Franz alone to pursue the truth.

Dorrenville, southwest of Macksohn, was normally about an hour away. To accommodate the weakened Yung, however, the carriage traveled at walking pace. Darkness fell and rain began. After briefly stopping to confer, they pressed on; the town center was close.

In Dorrenville, YHWH asked a passerby where they could stay and was directed to the Circus Inn. To escape the rain, however, the party stopped at the nearest tavern, The Drunk Man. It was quiet inside. After some bargaining with the owner, they secured a communal room for the night. They found the food too expensive, so only Lemmy, Franz, and Beau stayed to eat; the others found a busier restaurant elsewhere in town.
During the meal, YHWH asked Midori about the route to Fanaur. She explained that they would head south to New Morris, leave the carriage, and take a boat to Fanaur.
To protect their expensive carriage and Speedy, the party arranged to keep watch in pairs, making use of their ample numbers.

Ron and YHWH took the first watch, chatting on the carriage about whether Speedy might actually be a shapeshifted druid—and what the going rate for a druid might be. Eventually, Ron sensed something wrong across the street. As they went to investigate, a brief, piercing, high-pitched sound rang inside his head, with no discernible source. By the light of a bonfire YHWH conjured, Ron found a rough, metallic-looking piece of ore on the grass outside a house. Unsure what it was, they put it in the bag of holding for safekeeping. Tomorrow they would ask Siri, who "surely" knew all about minerals.

After their watch, YHWH strode back and knocked on the room's door, irritating his companions by waking them shortly after they had fallen asleep. Midori brought Beau, who was eager for her turn on watch, to join Lemmy by the carriage. Lemmy seemed to have something to tell Midori. Following Ron and YHWH's directions, they checked the spot across the street where the ore had been found. Midori felt a slight pain in her head. Lemmy then described the night Anedak and Jiaheng were killed. Apart from withholding the crucial family name, he gave her an almost entirely candid account; Beau showed little interest. Back at the carriage, he explained that ever since, he had had to report his day's experiences every night, and demonstrated. Beau suddenly noticed something odd about Midori's left forearm. Looking more closely, Midori found that both forearms had turned dark, with elephant-like skin and thick, short bristles, just like Brock's skin had been.

Midori clasped her hands, closed her eyes, and prayed to Keinra. As she listened for a response, a deafening bang rang out. She heard Beau scream and felt a sharp pain in her left arm. From Lemmy, she heard nothing at all.

Opening her eyes, Midori saw that Beau's right arm was gone from the shoulder down, while her own left arm was missing below the elbow. Despite the intense pain, their wounds appeared sealed rather than bloody. Her right hand hung limp as well. Lemmy had vanished, leaving only scattered pieces of flesh, scraps of his clothing, and the necklace that had once been worn by Tai Tai, then Uko, and finally Lemmy himself.

In his final moment of consciousness, Lemmy recalled his adventures with the party, his childhood in Macksohn, and how he had met his close friend Remmy. Then he heard Remmy's familiar voice: "LaShiv da Macksohn, come with me!" After that, there was nothing.

The explosion and Beau's screams echoed through Dorrenville. Neighbors came out to watch from a distance, and the adventurers rushed outside. Terrified and unable to speak, Beau knelt and repeatedly struck her head against the ground. They asked the tavern keeper to fetch a doctor. YHWH put on Lemmy's necklace, sensing a connection to Ultisen, the god of trickery he worshipped, and accompanied Midori and Franz back to their room. Franz carried Beau, who seemed to have passed out from exhaustion. Ron, Siri, and Samael, who had brought Kubao outside, remained in shock, trying to decide what to do. Samael left Kubao beside the carriage and joined the other two at the tavern entrance as several guests hurried out to see what had happened.

They soon heard a horse neighing wildly. An unfamiliar rider rounded the corner on Speedy. The three reacted quickly, scrambling to stop the thief and the horse with every trick they could muster, then working together to lead Speedy back. Ron tried questioning the thief, but Siri's spell had left the man laughing so hard that he could barely breathe, let alone answer.

As Samael brought Speedy back, he saw Kubao eating the pieces of flesh that had once been Lemmy. Furious, he dropped the reins to pick Kubao up. Speedy lunged forward, startling Kubao, who fled with a mouthful of flesh and collided with the exhausted Yung. Yung could manage only a weak whinny. Siri caught Speedy's reins and tied him beside the tavern, while Samael scooped Kubao up before he could eat any more. From outside the window, Samael heard singing in their room that reminded him of home. The language sounded familiar, yet did not seem to be Elvish.
After the commotion, the tavern door opened. The owner told Ron that the doctor had arrived, and everyone hurried back upstairs.

Back in the room with Franz and Beau, YHWH and Midori discussed their next move. Midori planned to continue to Fanaur once a doctor had stabilized her and Beau. Franz was furious: Beau had already lost an arm, and if they kept exposing her to danger, she might lose a leg next—or all her limbs before they ever reached Fanaur. Midori asked him to suggest something useful. Unable to think of a better plan, Franz paced for a while, then stormed out.

A knock came at the door. The tavern keeper brought in a woman with pale skin, silver-white hair, and white clothing; only her eyes, a vivid blue, broke the pattern. Appearing to be in her early twenties, she introduced herself as Dr. White, a local doctor. At Midori's request, she examined the sleeping Beau and seemed to recognize the Laxthos Cult's handiwork immediately. YHWH rose to tell the others the doctor had arrived, but the tavern keeper offered to do it instead. Dr. White sat beside Beau and began to sing. Her gentle, soothing voice helped Midori relax.

Samael, Ron, and Siri reached the doorway and saw the unfamiliar woman singing. When Samael asked who she was, she introduced herself as Dr. White in Common, then told him "Welcome home" in Elvish. A blinding white light filled the room, accompanied by Ron's roar: "I knew there was something strange about a girl who sings like that!" Siri fought the unfamiliar magic by sheer force of will. When he opened his eyes, he was alone. The door opened again, and Franz entered, looking bewildered. "Where is everyone? Why are they all gone?"
